Use the provided data dictionary context to assign a Data Subject Area to each data element in the batch input." } , { 'role' : 'user' , 'content' : "DATA DICTIONARY:

Data Subject Area | Description
Admissions | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the services related to individual patients and a healthcare provider in an inpatient care situation.
Adverse Patient Events | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about unexpected events, with potential to cause harm, illness or death to patients, that are required to be reported to command or governing authorities according to the laws, regulations and guidelines set by entities such as the FDA.
Allergies | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the description, documentation, treatment, and record of allergies and inflammatory responses of varying degrees of severity for individual patients.
Ancillary Patient Healthcare Services | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the healthcare services that support Healthcare Delivery and Preventive Medicine activities. Ancillary services include audiology and speech, behavioral health, dietetics, radiology, medical laboratory services, optometry, and medical prosthesis fabrication.
Appointments | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the services related to individual patients and a healthcare provider in an outpatient care situation.
Assessments | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the evaluation of individual patient to obtain pertinent health and health risk information. This includes the diagnostic procedures, a decision regarding the individuals health risks and health condition(s), and the development of a diagnosis (legal or informal).
Audiology & Speech | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the individual patients hearing and language pathology diagnosis and disorders.
Basic Training Recruitment and Medical Exams | 
Bed Status | 
Benefits-Disability | Benefit and health coverage information pertaining to those who have specific disabilities and cannot perform his/her duties. This usually includes additional benefits such as income, etc.
Benefits-Non-Health | Benefits afforded to active duty members such as mortgage and education assistance.
Brain & Spinal Cord | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the individual patients medical and rehabilitative data associated with the long, cordlike part of the central nervous system that is enclosed within the vertebral column (spine) and descends from the base of the brain. This includes all nerves that convey motor and sensory impulses to and from the tissues of the body.
Care Plans | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the individual patients Healthcare plan based on the diagnosis, prognosis and available resources, as well as the knowledge of the individual developing the draft healthcare maintenance (wellness) plan and draft treatment plan.
Catchments and PRISM areas | 
Causality Deceased | 
Claims | 
Clinical Decision Support | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about timely health and healthcare information that enhances decision-making in the clinical workflow setting. This metadata includes: alerts and reminders to care providers and patients, clinical guidelines, condition-specific order sets, diagnostic support, and contextually relevant reference data.
Clinician Notes | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the clinicians description and comments regarding the health of individual patients.
Consultations & Referrals | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the healthcare team participants, services, coordination, consultation results and similar items used to enable and document a referral to a consulted healthcare provider.
Contracts-Agreements | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about a legally-enforceable agreement between two or more parties, such as between a patient and a provider, or a provider and the payer having fiduciary responsibility for the patient. This domain includes such items as advance directives, and security/privacy-related constructs, and even includes corporate or jurisdictional policies where the patient is not individually identified (e.g., a standard privacy policy issued by a hospital). Currently the contents of this domain are nearly identical to the FHIR Contract resource, but some constructs may be replaced with or be reused by the Security And Privacy domain.
Coordinating Healthcare | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the individual patients assessment, care plan, consultation, observation and orders that is orchestrated and collaborated among other healthcare providers.
Data Query Request | 
Demographics | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about individuals that includes basic attributes that would apply to all people, e.g., person identifiers, names, dates of birth, dates of death, gender, race, contact information, and relationships to other persons.
Dental | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the individual patients details and summary of a dental status and plan of action.
Dental Readiness | 
Deployments | 
Diagnoses | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the type of injury, disease, ailment or health condition of individual patients.
Dietetics | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the individual patients nutritional facts, that includes dietary requests, dietetic modifications, supplemental feeding, nutritional status, food items, etc.
Disability Evaluations | 
Disability Information | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about a beneficiaries impairment due to disease or injury, regardless of degree, that reduces or prevents an individuals actual or presumed ability to engage in gainful employment or normal activity. The term "disability" or "physical disability" includes mental disease, but not such inherent defects as developmental or behavioral disorders. Description utilizes verbiage from  DoDi 1332.18, "Disability Evaluation System," November 10, 2022 definition of a disability.
Discharge & Transfers | 
Discharge Transfer | 
Disease Non-Battle Injury | 
Documents | 
Duty-Specific Physical Information and Status | Information related to specialized duty physical information. This could include, flight physical status, dive physical status, jump physical status, submarine physical status, and etc.
EDIPNs | 
Encounter Reports | 
Encounters | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the services related to individual patients and a healthcare provider in an inpatient, outpatient, or in the emergency care situation.
Enrollment & Eligibility | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the permissible healthcare services for a given population or individual beneficiary, based on policies and regulations (e.g., predetermined priority groups).
Family History | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the individual patients family members, particularly biology relationships, past or present medical diagnosis, treatments, and conditions, including cause of death.
Functional Status | 
Genomic-Precision Medicine | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about the individual patients DNA description, documentation, treatment, and record for genetic testing or research.
Genomic Precision Medicine | 
Geographic | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about physical locations and conceptual boundaries relative to healthcare business operations.
HIA Priv | 
Health Concerns | 
Health Risks | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about probability and severity of health hazards, risk mitigation objectives, risk mitigation plan, population health educational material, health risk reduction policies, public health alerts and actions.
Health Services | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about command and control of the healthcare mission and resources, healthcare support, healthcare administration, and healthcare operations.
Health Surveillance | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about disease outbreaks, behavioral health issues, reportable medical events and non-medical data from external sources.
Healthcare Access | Data subject area that categorizes logical design metadata about enrollment and eligibility determination, healthcare services authorization, medical information and patient movement administration, and health beneficiary services support.
